senses.gloss: म्लै vi. 1P (pp. म्लान; pres. म्लायति) 1. To grow weary, to be fatigued, मम्लुतुर्न मणिकुट्टिमोचितौ R.xi.9; 2. to be sad, to be dispirited, मम्लौ साथ विषादेन पद्मिनीव हिमांभसा K.Pr.x.; 3. to wither, to fade; 4. to become thin, to be emaciated.With परि- 1. to be dejected, to be dispirited, R.xiv.50, K.S.ii.2; 2. to fade, to wither.With प्र-, 1. to fade, to wither; 2. to be dejected; 3. to be dirty, to be soiled.
